findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "employers" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: compare_job_posting, request_competitive_hiring_report · Public sink: request_competitive_hiring_report.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: compare_job_posting, request_competitive_hiring_report · Public sink: request_competitive_hiring_report

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
